01 /

Start with a verified email

Create an account with your name, email and a password of at least 12 characters including letters and numbers. Enter the six-digit code sent to your inbox to finish sign-up. Password login also requires an email code.

  • Codes expire after 10 minutes and allow five attempts.
  • You can request another code after 60 seconds; the new code replaces the old one.
02 /

Fund your wallet

Open your wallet and choose an available deposit method. Card deposits credit after confirmed Stripe payment. Manual deposits credit after administrator verification. Your new account begins with a zero balance.

03 /

Choose your approach

Make your own sports selections or fund a copy staking position. Review the amount, odds or strategy settings before confirming. Both approaches can lose funds; returns are never guaranteed.

Compare copy staking ↗
04 /

Follow settlement

After the administrator records a final score, EDGE determines the outcome and settles the affected stakes. Winning returns credit the wallet; copied results update the position. A losing stake reduces the funds committed to that game.

05 /

Verify before withdrawing

Submit the identity details and documents requested for your account. An administrator must approve KYC before you can withdraw. Payout requests reserve the requested funds and remain subject to review.
